# FastAPI API Reference

> Complete bilingual API and CLI reference for FastAPI v0.162.2 — every public class, parameter descriptor, dependency, security extractor, response, SSE/telemetry API, OpenAPI helper, and CLI command.

## Catalog

- [FastAPI Package Overview](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/00_overview.html): FastAPI v0.162.2 is a high-performance ASGI web framework for building HTTP, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and WebSocket APIs in Python using standard type…
- [fastapi.applications](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/01_applications.html): The fastapi.applications module defines the FastAPI ASGI application class (subclassing starlette.applications.Starlette), orchestrating OpenAPI 3.1.0…
- [fastapi.routing](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/02_routing.html): The fastapi.routing module implements modular route composition (APIRouter), Pydantic-validated HTTP path operations (APIRoute), dependency-injected…
- [fastapi.params](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/03_parameters.html): The fastapi.params and fastapi.param_functions modules (re-exported directly from fastapi) provide declarative parameter descriptors—Path(), Query()…
- [fastapi.dependencies](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/04_dependencies.html): FastAPI's dependency injection (DI) system resolves hierarchical callable graphs per request, automatically validating sub-dependency parameters, caching…
- [fastapi.security](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/05_security.html): fastapi.security provides callable authentication extractors, credential models, and form parsers that extract credentials from incoming HTTP connections…
- [fastapi.requests & websockets](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/06_requests_websockets.html): FastAPI exposes Starlette's ASGI connection primitives through fastapi.requests (Request, HTTPConnection) and fastapi.websockets (WebSocket…
- [fastapi.responses](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/07_responses.html): fastapi.responses re-exports Starlette's ASGI response classes (Response, JSONResponse, HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse, StreamingResponse…
- [fastapi.sse](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/08_sse.html): Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming response marker, validated event payload model, UTF-8 wire-format serializer, and automatic idle keep-alive constant…
- [fastapi.datastructures](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/09_datastructures.html): Spooled file upload wrapper, immutable ASGI request containers, mutable application/request state namespace, and default-override sentinel helpers imported…
- [fastapi.exceptions](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/10_exceptions.html): HTTP, WebSocket, request/response validation, and dependency-scope exception classes imported from fastapi.exceptions, paired with built-in ASGI exception…
- [fastapi.middleware](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/11_middleware.html): Built-in ASGI security, origin policy, compression, TLS redirection, and request file cleanup middleware classes imported from fastapi.middleware.* and…
- [fastapi.telemetry](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/12_telemetry.html): Native OpenTelemetry configuration, per-request contextual state, and synchronous processor lookup imported from fastapi.telemetry (TelemetryConfig…
- [fastapi.openapi](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/13_openapi.html): OpenAPI 3.1.0 (JSON Schema 2020-12) schema generation (fastapi.openapi.utils), interactive documentation HTML builders (fastapi.openapi.docs), schema…
- [fastapi.background & utilities](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/14_utilities.html): Post-response task scheduling (fastapi.background), recursive JSON-compatible conversion (fastapi.encoders), AnyIO worker threadpool execution helpers…
- [fastapi.testclient & cli](https://fastapi.drawlib.com/api/en/15_testing_and_cli.html): Synchronous in-process HTTP, WebSocket, and ASGI lifespan testing via TestClient (fastapi.testclient), paired with the fastapi command-line interface…
